description: US drinking water quality report — Safe-drinking-water report card for any US public water system from EPA SDWIS: system profile (population served, source water, owner, purchased vs own supply), every violation on file with plain-English category and contaminant (health-based vs monitoring, open vs returned to compliance, public notice tier), 10-year counts by category and contaminant, the latest lead and copper 90th-percentile results against EPA action levels, and a verdict (ACTIVE HEALTH-BASED VIOLATION / LEAD ACTION LEVEL EXCEEDED / RECENT HEALTH-BASED VIOLATION / NO CURRENT VIOLATIONS) with a LOW/MODERATE/HIGH risk level. Look up by pwsid= (e.g. TN0000494) or by city= plus state= (picks the largest community system and lists the others). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: env_drinking_water
